Bajaj Auto Q2 results: Standalone profit rises 35% to ₹3,354 crore
items.summary:
Bajaj Auto on Tuesday reported a 35 per cent jump in standalone profit after tax to Rs 3,354 crore in the three months to September compared to the corresponding quarter of the last financial year.
The company had posted a standalone profit after tax of Rs 2,480 crore in the July-September period of FY 26.
Revenue from operations for the quarter under review stood at Rs 20,003 crore, up 34 per cent year-on-year from Rs 14,922 crore in the September quarter last year.
EBITDA (earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation) climbed 37 per cent to Rs 4,172 crore in Q2 FY27 against Rs 3,052 crore in the same quarter of FY26, the company said in a statement. EBITDA Margin rose 40 basis points to 20.9 per cent in Q2 FY27 against 20.5 per cent in the second quarter of the year earlier, the company said.
